# Climbing finger training

## How I got into it
Clara from the step-down unit dragged me to Hangar Nine Bouldering on Geary Ave in October 2024. Now Mondays with her, 10-visit punch card $165. I climb V3, some V4 slab, overhang is a disaster.

## Hangboard at home
Beastmaker 1000 above the bedroom door, mounted on a 2×10 board with 6 lag bolts into the studs on 2024-12-28. Dev checked the studs twice.

Protocol (Lattice-style repeaters, only twice a week, never the day before climbing):
- warmup: 2 min jug hangs, 3 × 10 s on the big edge
- 20 mm edge, half crimp, open hand on the pinky
- 7 s on / 3 s off × 6 = one set, 3 min rest, 5 sets
- bodyweight only, nothing added until the A2 heals properly

## The pulley tweak
2024-12-14, left ring finger, A2 pulley, felt a little pop on a crimpy V3 at Hangar Nine. Not a full rupture (could still make a fist, no bowstringing). 2 weeks off, then H-taping and very light hangs with feet on a chair. Back to normal by mid-February 2025.
